title: Tangent and Angles of a Circle

items.question: Find the value of $x$ ($AB$ is a tangent at $B$, $OB$ a radius, $\angle BAO = 38^\circ$, $x = \angle AOB$).

steps.en: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact.
steps.ur: مماس نقطہ تماس پر رداس کے عمود ہوتا ہے۔

steps.en: The angles of a triangle add to $180^\circ$.

items.question: Find the angle $ABC$ ($AB$ and $AC$ are tangents from $A$, $\angle BAC = 65^\circ$).

steps.en: Tangents from an external point are equal, so triangle $ABC$ is isosceles.
steps.ur: بیرونی نقطے سے مماس برابر ہوتے ہیں، اس لیے مثلث متساوی الساقین ہے۔

steps.en: The angles of a triangle add to $180^\circ$.
steps.ur: مثلث کے زاویوں کا مجموعہ $180^\circ$ ہے۔

items.question: $A$, $B$ and $C$ are points on the circumference of a circle with centre at $O$. $\overline{AC}$ is the diameter of the circle and $\overleftrightarrow{DE}$ is the tangent to the circle at the point $C$ and $m\angle BCD = 62^\circ$. Find (i) $m\angle BCA$ (ii) $m\angle BAC$

steps.en: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact.
steps.ur: مماس نقطہ تماس پر رداس کے عمود ہوتا ہے۔

steps.en: Subtract the given angle.
steps.ur: دیا گیا زاویہ تفریق کریں۔

steps.en: Alternate segment theorem: the angle between a tangent and a chord equals the angle in the alternate segment.
steps.ur: متبادل قطعہ کا مسئلہ: مماس اور وتر کے درمیان زاویہ متبادل قطعے کے زاویے کے برابر ہوتا ہے۔

items.question: $D$, $E$ and $F$ are points on the circumference of a circle with centre at $O$ and $m\angle DOF = 130^\circ$. Find $m\angle DEF$.

steps.en: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference on the same arc.
steps.ur: ایک ہی قوس پر مرکزی زاویہ محیطی زاویے کا دگنا ہوتا ہے۔

items.question: $X$, $Y$ and $Z$ are points on the circumference of a circle with centre at $O$ and $m\angle XYZ = 85^\circ$. Find $x$ ($x = \angle XOZ$ on the same arc).

steps.en: The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference on the same arc.
steps.ur: ایک ہی قوس پر مرکزی زاویہ محیطی زاویے کا دگنا ہوتا ہے۔

items.question: In a historical monument, a circular fountain with a radius of 3 m is built. A flagpole is erected 7 m away from the centre of the fountain. Two ropes from the pole are tied to the edge of the fountain, just touching it. Find the length of each rope.

steps.en: Pythagoras in the right triangle formed by the radius, the tangent and the line to the centre.
steps.ur: رداس، مماس اور مرکز تک کے خط سے بننے والی قائمہ مثلث میں فیثا غورث۔

steps.en: Solve for $L$.
steps.ur: $L$ معلوم کریں۔

items.question: Two circular gears touch each other externally for proper rotation in a machine. The radii of the two circular gears are 5 cm and 7 cm. What is the distance between their centres if they touch externally?

steps.en: Circles touching externally: distance between centres = sum of the radii.
steps.ur: بیرونی طور پر ملنے والے دائروں کے مراکز کا فاصلہ = رداسوں کا مجموعہ۔

items.question: A small sensor lies inside a satellite dish and touches its wall internally. If the dish has radius 15 cm and the sensor has radius 2.5 cm, find the distance between their centres.

steps.en: Circles touching internally: distance between centres = difference of the radii.
steps.ur: اندرونی طور پر ملنے والے دائروں کے مراکز کا فاصلہ = رداسوں کا فرق۔

items.question: An inner holder touches the outer cylindrical container internally. If the outer container has radius 8 cm and the inner holder has radius 6 cm, find the distance between their centres.

steps.en: Internal contact: difference of the radii.
steps.ur: اندرونی تماس: رداسوں کا فرق۔

items.question: A pyramid-shaped sculpture is placed in the center of a circular plaza with a radius of 10 m. A decorative pole stands 26 m from the center of the circle. Two guide wires are attached from the pole to the plaza edge, just touching the circle. Find the length of each wire.

steps.en: Pythagoras in the right triangle formed by the radius, the tangent and the line to the centre.
steps.ur: رداس، مماس اور مرکز تک کے خط سے بننے والی قائمہ مثلث میں فیثا غورث۔

items.question: In a circular arch over a monument entrance, two spotlight fixtures are placed such that they each shine from two different points on the arch to the same chord $PQ$ on the base of the arch. If the angle formed at one light is $55^\circ$, what is the angle at the second light on the same side of chord $PQ$?

steps.en: Angles in the same segment (on the same chord, same side) are equal.

steps.ur: قوس کی لمبائی $= r\theta$۔

items.question: Four possible answers are given for the following questions. Choose the correct answer.

parts.label: i
parts.prompt: Tangent is a line that touches the circumference of the circle at: (a) $\text{many points}$ (b) $\text{three points}$ (c) $\text{two points}$ (d) $\text{one point}$

steps.en: A tangent touches at exactly one point.
steps.ur: مماس صرف ایک نقطے پر چھوتا ہے۔

steps.en: Choose the option that matches the working.
steps.ur: وہ جواب چنیں جو حل سے مطابقت رکھتا ہو۔

parts.label: ii
parts.prompt: ______ tangents can be drawn to a circle from a point outside the circle. (a) $\text{one}$ (b) $\text{two}$ (c) $\text{three}$ (d) $\text{many}$

steps.en: Exactly two tangents from an external point.
steps.ur: بیرونی نقطے سے دو مماس۔

steps.en: Choose the option that matches the working.
steps.ur: وہ جواب چنیں جو حل سے مطابقت رکھتا ہو۔

parts.label: iii
parts.prompt: ______ tangents can be drawn to a circle from centre of the circle. (a) $\text{zero}$ (b) $\text{one}$ (c) $\text{two}$ (d) $\text{three}$

steps.en: The centre is inside the circle: no tangent.
steps.ur: مرکز دائرے کے اندر ہے: کوئی مماس نہیں۔

steps.en: Choose the option that matches the working.
steps.ur: وہ جواب چنیں جو حل سے مطابقت رکھتا ہو۔

parts.label: iv
parts.prompt: In circle, radius and tangent are: (a) $\text{parallel}$ (b) $\text{equal}$ (c) $\text{perpendicular}$ (d) $\text{zero}$

steps.en: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact.

parts.label: v

steps.en: In the major segment the angle is acute.

steps.en: It is the central angle.
